description: Wrong loop start index in normaliseStructure: starting at 0 instead of 1 will try to process the master element as a duplicate of itself, causing it to remove its own child nodes or throw errors.
Wrong comparison operator in normaliseStructure: using >= instead of > will fail to detect duplicate elements when there are multiple ones, leaving duplicates unmerged.
original: if (elements.size() > 1) { // dupes, move contents to master
mutated: if (elements.size() >= 1) { // dupes, move contents to master

description: Swapped arguments in normaliseStructure call: passing htmlEl as the tag name and head as the element will cause tag lookup to fail or look for the wrong structure.
Missing normalisation order for the document itself: omitting normaliseTextNodes(this) will leave loose text nodes directly inside the Document root un-pulled into the body.
Wrong target element check for body: checking head() instead of body() when checking for missing body will cause it to append a body element twice or miss the check.
